title: TERM=dumb and IA_NO_CONSOLE keep bare ia out of the console
summary: Bare ia now also prints the same help as ia --help, instead of opening the console, when TERM is exactly dumb or IA_NO_CONSOLE is set to any non-empty value; an unset TERM does not opt out. Scripts that run under a pseudo-terminal can set IA_NO_CONSOLE=1 or call ia --help.
